instruction:
Open `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\prod_design.PrjPcb` in Altium Designer, add two variants to the project, and save the result as `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\prod_design.PrjPcb`. The exact variant specification is given in `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\variant_spec.json` and must be matched precisely.

Requirements:
- Variant 1 - `Production`:
- Its Description must contain `Production`.
- Mark these 7 components as Not Fitted \ DNP: `J5`, `D10`, `D11`, `D12`, `R20`, `R21`, `R22`.
- Set `U3` to an Alternate Part with `Library Reference = MCU_STM32F405RGT6`, `Manufacturer = GigaDevice`, and `MPN = GD32F405RGT6`; `U3` must still remain fitted.
- Variant 2 - `Debug`:
- Its Description must contain `Debug` (case-insensitive).
- All components must remain fitted; none may be DNP.
source: task.md #48 (Altium 'Working with the Variant Manager'; 'Design Variants'; AltiumLive 2022 'Avoiding Supply Chain Issues with Variants')
